newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, blue chips stagnate.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, blue chips stagnate.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed in slower trade on Friday, with blue chips staggering and hoteliers posting new gains.
* Eight of 18 active issues rose, six fell and four were flat.
* Volume down at 5,686 units, turnover lower at 4.9 million kuna.
* Biggest gainer textile firm Varteks added five kuna or six percent to 85, on volume of 60 shares.
* Biggest decliner shipper Atlantska plovidba lost eight kuna or 6.7 percent to 102 on volume of 50 shares.
* Most active issue was Zagrebacka Banka's bearer stock, gaining 6 kuna to 1,100 on volume of 1,583 shares.
